title: Assaults at Dormitories involving Migrant Workers from Different Nationalities
what_it_is: Assaults at Dormitories involving Migrant Workers from Different Nationalities

sections.label: Dormitory safety and security measures
sections.summary: Few cases involve different races and none reported racially motivated; Police and dormitory operators work on safety and security arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: A minority of the cases involve persons of different races.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As far as we are aware, none were reported to be racially motivated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police work with the dormitory operators on safety and security issues.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The operators are required as part of licensing conditions under the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), to put in place security arrangements, including closed circuit television systems and deployment of security officers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police also work with the operators to engage dormitory residents on crime prevention and safety and security matters.
